name: watch-for-me
description: Watch a video without playing it: from a local path or a URL (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok…) it extracts key frames (interval sampling + scene-cut detection), contact sheets and an optional audio transcript, summarizes everything into SUMMARY.md and leaves the agent ready to answer questions about the video. Instagram resolves itself (headless browser, no login, no cookies). Cross-platform; manages its own dependencies.
